principles: Adapter evidence gate scope must stay semantic and narrow
Routine validation should catch regressions without weakening gates
Local evidence must not be described as Authority or production proof
drivers: Baseline dimension 3 requires provider-only Codex text not to trigger adapter evidence
Actual Codex adapter surfaces must still require verification
dist is ignored, so test execution must prove rebuilt runtime behavior

options.name: smoke-and-validation-wiring
pros: Captures the actual regression target directly
Avoids changing runtime matching when current logic is already correct
Runs against built dist after build
cons: Adds another validation command, so validate has a small extra cost

options.name: change-runtime-matcher
pros: Could be used if smoke proves source behavior is wrong
cons: Risky without evidence because current matcher already appears adapter-surface-only
Could accidentally weaken adapter evidence requirements

options.name: documentation-only-result
cons: Would not mechanically catch future provider-only false positives or source/dist drift

rationale: The narrow smoke plus validation wiring proves the real baseline issue without arbitrary runtime changes, and it keeps adapter surfaces fail-closed.

preMortem.scenario: Provider-only fixture accidentally includes an adapter keyword such as verify_codex
preMortem.trigger: The smoke haystack is not carefully separated
preMortem.consequence: The test would falsely claim provider-only text requires no evidence while actually testing adapter text
preMortem.mitigation: Use separate provider-only and adapter-surface cases with explicit expected booleans.

preMortem.scenario: New smoke imports source instead of rebuilt dist
preMortem.consequence: A missing rebuild/install step could still escape
preMortem.mitigation: Run npm build first and import from dist task in validation.

preMortem.scenario: Validation wiring makes full validate materially slower
preMortem.trigger: Smoke does heavy filesystem setup or external commands
preMortem.mitigation: Use a small in-memory fake store and no network or subprocess calls.
